desc: Like all Bond Arms, the Grizzly features stainless-steel barrels and frames, cross-bolt safety, retracting firing pins, spring-loaded cam-lock lever and rebounding hammer. The Grizzly's 3-inch barrel, with blade front sight and fixed rear sight, is chambered in .45 Long Colt and 2-inch .410 bore shotshells. Vibrant rosewood grips engraved with grizzly bear artwork, the Bond Arms name and a checkered panel, add texture and character to the pistol. The pistol includes a matching leather holster embossed with a grizzly bear.
